description: The man wears a richly bordered dark forest-green wool tunic reaching above the knees, with gold-brown knotwork along its front opening, cuffs and hem. A cream underlayer shows at the wrists and lower edge. A large green-and-brown checked cloak crosses the shoulders and chest, fastened near his right shoulder by a round knotwork brooch and falling down both sides with fringe. A broad decorated leather belt has large round gold fittings. Soft brown leather wrist coverings are tied over the sleeve fabric. Brown trousers and tall dark leather boots complete the opaque clothing.
